lia: Quick FYI 4 I'm drafting a tiny Optimize Toolkit FAQ about micro-batching + caching when using quantized models. Intend to include one short decision paragraph, a 1-line migration note, and two tiny snippets (Python sync + curl). Looking for quick reviews.

omar: Sounds good. Keep snippets <10 lines and use <model-name> placeholders. I'll check the Python API shape.

lia: Draft decision blurb: "Micro-batching improves throughput under sustained concurrency but can increase tail latency for single-user short sessions. With quantized kernels, kv_prefetch may raise peak RAM72benchmark representative workloads and set kv_prefetch explicitly in examples."

omar: Strong. Migration one-liner: "Older examples defaulted to kv_prefetch on; with quantized runtimes that can increase memoryexplicitly set and benchmark."

lia: Python snippet (tiny):

```py
# pseudocode - redwood python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = c.generate({"model":"<model-name>", "max_tokens":48, "batching":{"type":"micro","max_batch_tokens":256}, "kv_prefetch":False})
print(resp.text)
```

omar: Looks good. For long-batch workloads add a note to try kv_prefetch=True.

lia: curl smoke example (for quick verification):

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"<model-name>","max_tokens":48,"batching":{"type":"micro","max_batch_tokens":256},"kv_prefetch":false}'
```

noah: docs-bot will remind about samplegen. Please add samplegen metadata under optimize/microbatch-quant in the PR.

docs-bot: Reminder: include samplegen metadata and run code-block linting per CONTRIBUTING.md#samplegen.

omar: I'll run a quick perf smoke against a Q4 quant build and post a one-line finding for the FAQ.

lia: Thanks 4 opening a WIP PR and tagging @omar @noah for review. Targeting quick merge after lint + perf check. :rocket:
